data.statement: The three truthful v4 creatives now total 214 public impressions: goat 131 with two Pin clicks and one save, alligator 68, and ceramic eye 15. The five impressions added since 2026-08-25 produced no new engagement, outbound click, attributable Pinterest session, or affiliate click.
data.decision: Keep the corrected goat as the only directional attention leader and keep all three published candidates in measurement; the new v6 creative is justified by a distinct verified catalog-product hypothesis rather than this small performance increment.
data.nextAction: Continue public-only measurement and never use Sandbox or Pinterest v3 as traffic evidence.
